detail: GEV: $150.2B RPO as stated in the FY2025 10-K (tier reported) - already present
PWR: $23.8B RPO; backlog $44.0B (tier reported) - already present

notes: No existing values were changed. All EV figures are price-derived (tier estimated) with full arithmetic shown in each note; market caps and debt/cash figures are reused unchanged from the resolved Atlas records with citations to those records and their 10-K sources.

All EV market caps are dated Oct 6, 2026 per the existing records (not Oct 7); the Oct 7, 2026 prices from prices.json were NOT substituted, per the v15 rule to reuse the existing resolved market-cap figure and cite it.
pe-trailing gaps for TLN (-$4.79 EPS) and BE (-$0.37 EPS) remain null/unsourced: negative TTM GAAP EPS makes a trailing P/E meaningless. The records already carry these as null/unsourced; unchanged.
rev-cagr-5y gaps for TLN (bankruptcy emergence May 2023, no FY2020 filing) and GEV (GE spin-off Apr 2024, no FY2020 filing) remain null/unsourced: no 5-year anchor exists. Unchanged.

Task text listed 'pfcf for BE' as a gap to fill, but BE's record already has Price / free cash flow 1451.0x ($83.0B / $57.2M, tier estimated) and G-energy.json lists no pfcf gap for BE. No action taken; flagged for the parent's awareness.
Task text referenced pe-trailing for 'LITE-not-in-bundle'; LITE is outside bundle G. No action taken.

Triple-check: source check - EV inputs cite the resolved records and their named 10-Ks; name/arithmetic check - each EV recomputed from display inputs (math in notes), company names match 10-K legal entities; consistency check - no ISO/display dates involved, and the figures agree with the records' net-debt lines (debt minus cash).
Verification per the Two-Person Rule still needs an independent pass before these EV figures go live.
